draft.emotion: relaxed and conversational, meeting a friend for a drink
notes: In casual speech, people often just say đi cà phê ('to go for coffee') instead of naming the shop.
Traditional Vietnamese quán cà phê often have low stools on the pavement rather than indoor tables.
